source_en: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. Originally a blocky structure, its equilibrium is broken, and its Remnant Energy has mostly dissipated.

source_en: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.

source_en: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a delicate equilibrium and, after centrifugation, its concentrated product becomes widely useful.

source_en: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. Its equilibrium has been disrupted, and the remaining Remnant Energy has decayed to mere Reverberations.
new_translation_vi: Một tàn tích Waveworn nứt vỡ theo hình nan quạt. Trạng thái cân bằng của nó đã bị phá vỡ, và Năng Lượng Tàn Dư còn lại giờ chỉ còn là những Dư Âm suy tàn.

source_en: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.
